create_ReacherBulletEnv: create a ReacherBulletEnv instance to simulate a 2D reaching robot in a zero-gravity PyBullet scene
create_PusherBulletEnv: create a PusherBulletEnv instance to simulate a 7-DOF robot arm pushing an object toward a target
create_StrikerBulletEnv: create a StrikerBulletEnv instance to simulate a 7-DOF robot arm striking an object toward a target
create_ThrowerBulletEnv: create a ThrowerBulletEnv instance to simulate a 7-DOF robot arm throwing an object toward a target
step_ReacherBulletEnv: step a ReacherBulletEnv with action array to apply torques and compute reward from potential and electricity cost
